explanationMd: Complete both squares: (x−4)²+(y+3)²=11+16+9=36. The radius is √36=6. The added square-completion constants must also be added on the right.

distractorRationale.a: The constant before completing squares is not the squared radius.
distractorRationale.b: This comes from the distance of the center from the origin, not the radius.
